verdicts.reason: A is a jumbled strip. The 'Book a Studio Place' CTA is the largest element and crowds out the headline, which is missing or illegible. One schedule row ('02 DEC Printmaking with Ines Varga') is blown up while the rest of the list is microscopic. Elements collide at the top-left, and the logo and image are reduced to specks. B is just the portrait original shrunk into the middle of the banner, leaving huge empty bands on both sides and making every word, including the headline and CTA, unreadable. A is less bad only because its CTA and one event can be read.
